In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], a group of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] children on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] orchestrated the '''rescue''' of [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] [[Ghostling]] children from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]].
